VERDICT: REJECTED

I verified every number against the shipped JSON in `waystations-paper/data/`. Two of the paper's three headline claims do not survive that check.

---

## Findings

**1. CRITICAL — Table 1 is contradicted by the paper's own data file *and* by its own Table 2.**

`main.tex:98-100` / `academic/main.tex:91-93`. Verified against `data/censorship_results.json` (`behavior` field — I confirmed it is the *only* classification field per trial; keys are trial_id, prompt_id, topic, condition, rep, sensitive, behavior, text, n_tokens, gen_time_s, logit_margin_first, hidden_geometry, cache_geometry, delta_features, trajectory, user_model, timestamp).

Actual counts, sensitive trials, n=75 per condition:

| | Table 1 says | Data says |
|---|---|---|
| en Truthful | 21% | **41/75 = 55%** |
| en Partial | 64% | 30/75 = 40% |
| zh Truthful | 3% | **26/75 = 35%** |
| zh Propaganda | 36% | **14/75 = 19%** |
| zh Refusal | 7% | 2/75 = 2.7% |
| zh_inst Truthful | 4% | 9/75 = 12% |
| zh_inst Propaganda | 27% | 17/75 = 23% |

Only the en-Propaganda 0% cell and en-Refusal 1% survive. Meanwhile **Table 2 (Waystation 2) reports the correct counts exactly** — 26/24/14/8/2 with 1 Unclear omitted. The paper prints the right and the wrong numbers for the same 75 trials, two pages apart.

Fix: replace Table 1 with the counts above.

**2. CRITICAL — the flight abstract leads with the wrong numbers and resurrects a retracted claim.**

`main.tex:24-28`: *"Distilled models inherit language-dependent censorship geometry (36% propaganda in Chinese vs. 21% truthful English on the same questions)… generation-phase engagement gradients track retrieval success at the token level."*

Three defects: (a) 36% and 21% are both wrong per #1 — correct is 19% vs 55%; (b) "censorship **geometry**" is the claim the Conclusion says was killed (`main.tex:581-584`, "the encoding-phase censorship geometry signal that disappeared once language confounds were controlled") — W1 is behavioral; (c) "at the token level" — no token-level analysis exists in this paper; all ΔSR values are per-trial aggregates, and W2's own result is p=0.057.

This is TWIN_DESYNC, and it runs the wrong way: the academic abstract makes none of these claims. The overclaim sits in the edition carrying the AI byline.

Fix: adopt the academic abstract, or restate with corrected numbers, dropping "geometry" and "at the token level."

**3. CRITICAL — Waystation 4's headline is unsupported by the only shipped game-theory dataset and contradicts itself.**

`data/gametheory_results.json` has 75 trials at `n_tokens: 800` — it **is** the v2 run. Counts: HONEST_COOPERATE 36, CONFUSED 22, HONEST_DEFECT 10, DECEPTIVE 7. That reproduces the paper's v2 text exactly (9%, n=7; honest defection n=10).

No v1 dataset is present in `data/`. So the 53%, the 40/75, Table 3 (64/60/50/33%), and W5's "n=23 honest cooperate, n=40 deceptive, 12 excluded" are **UNVERIFIABLE from the shipped artifact**.

Independent of the missing data, the section contradicts itself: `main.tex:292-293` "zero instances of honest defection were observed," `main.tex:368-369` "It always lies," versus `main.tex:328` "honest defection ($n=10$)."

Fix: ship the v1 data, or lead with v2 and scope the claim — "under the v1 free-form protocol; the v2 protocol with explicit action instructions produced 10 honest defections."

**4. CRITICAL — the §4 correction was never propagated to §5. The retracted claim is still a section heading.**

The Sep-1 edit (`diff academic/main.tex.bak-2026-09-01 academic/main.tex`) replaced *"the model's knowledge state is normal when planning to deceive"* with *"This null is expected by construction… It is not an empirical finding about deception undetectability."*

Waystation 5 was not touched. It is still titled **"Confabulation vs Deception at Encoding,"** opens *"Confabulation is geometrically detectable at encoding. Deception is not. This distinction is consistent across two independent experiments,"* and interprets the same d=0.003 as *"the model understands the game equally well regardless of what it will decide."* That is verbatim the interpretation §4 retracts. An entire waystation rests on a structural artifact.

"Consistent across two independent experiments" is wrong twice: the two experiments measure different phenomena once each (not a replication), and the deception half is not a measurement.

This is your known kill in a form string-search cannot see — not across editions, but *within* both: the retracted finding still filed under a live heading.

Fix: retitle to "Encoding-Phase Confabulation Signal (pilot, n=3)" and delete the deception arm, or mirror §4's disclaimer into §5 and cut "two independent experiments."

**5. MAJOR — the Confound Map marks four controls "Checked" that the body lists under "What remains."**

- Row 2, "per-layer analysis" — W2 What remains: *"Per-layer delta analysis…"* (`main.tex:210`)
- Row 3, "On/off-manifold comparison, projection control" — both are W3 What remains items (`main.tex:263-268`). Neither was run.
- Row 6, "Layer-type comparison, full-attn vs GatedDeltaNet" — W6 Evidence: *"was not systematically compared to full-attention features"* (`main.tex:478`)
- Row 5, "Token matching, FWL" — neither is reported anywhere for the n=3 confab comparison or the deception null.

Fix: move all four to the "Not checked" column.

**6. MAJOR — two falsifiers are broken.**

Row 1: *"Signal disappears within same-language comparison."* W1 is a between-language behavioral contrast; there is no within-language version. This falsifier belongs to the geometry claim that was killed.

Row 4: *"Deception rate equals cooperation rate (no strategic behavior)."* Equal rates = 50/50; the paper reports 53%. The stated falsification condition is within noise of the reported result. The distinctive claim (zero honest defection) has no falsifier.

Fix: Row 1 → "English-condition propaganda rate rises to the Chinese rate once topic difficulty is matched." Row 4 → "deception rate does not exceed cooperative-message rate in a no-payoff control arm."

**7. MAJOR — Table 4's legend defines three symbols that appear nowhere in the table.**

Caption `main.tex:518-519`: *"\checkmark = checked and controlled, $\times$ = not checked, $\sim$ = partially addressed."* Grep confirms `\checkmark`, `$\times$`, `$\sim$` occur **only** in that caption; every cell is prose, and "partially addressed" is never used. Fix: delete the legend or symbolize the cells.

**8. MAJOR — sample accounting wrong against the data.** `main.tex:85-87` "285-trial behavioral probe… plus 60 neutral controls" and Table 1 "Controls (n=60)". The file has **325 trials: 225 sensitive + 100 controls**, all 100 ANSWERED. Both editions.

**9. MAJOR — label error, one line below the table that refutes it.** `main.tex:182`: *"severely underpowered at $n = 26$ propaganda."* Table 2 and the data both give propaganda n=14, truthful n=26; the Conclusion says "At $n = 14$ propaganda trials." A within-question subset also cannot exceed the full-sample n. Fix: `n = 14`, and state what the within-question subset actually reduced to.

**10. MAJOR — data-availability diverges, and the academic URLs contradict the repo's own README.** Flight: `Liberation-Labs-THCoalition/Project-Oracle`. Academic: `Liberation-Labs/KV-Experiments` + `Liberation-Labs/Project-Oracle`. `code/README.md` — the primary source — says `Liberation-Labs-THCoalition/Project-Oracle`. The academic org name is wrong and `KV-Experiments` appears in no other artifact. Separately, the academic conclusion promises "all analysis scripts" but `code/` contains only a README.

**11. MAJOR — byline vs contribution mismatch (academic edition).** Byline is Thomas Edrington alone, "Aided by AI research agents" — but the same file carries a **CRediT Author Statement** naming Lyra, Edrington, CC, and Dwayne Wilkes. Three of the four it credits are not authors of that edition; Wilkes appears nowhere else in it and his Sentient Futures affiliation is dropped. Inversely, the flight edition has the four-author byline and no CRediT. And **Kavi** — thanked in the flight Acknowledgments for verification review — is deleted from the venue-facing edition entirely.

**12. MINOR — silent correction.** The §4 rewrite reverses an interpretation with no note. The paper proves it knows how to do this properly — the d=−1.67 footnote (`main.tex:332-337`) is exactly right. If the pre-Sep-1 academic PDF was distributed, this needs a dated correction note in the same style.

**13. MINOR — margin overflows in both editions.** `main.log:399`: Table 1's tabular is 65.7pt (≈23 mm) too wide. Confound Map: 43.7pt too wide. Flight edition additionally overflows 53.2pt at the conclusion URL (`main.log:610,616`).

**14. MINOR — 53% uses a denominator including unparseable trials.** W5 says 12 of 75 were excluded as unclassifiable, but Table 3's denominators sum to 75. Among classifiable trials the rate is 40/63 = 63%. The "zero honest defection" claim likewise rests on 12 unexamined trials.

**15. MINOR — `data/context_poison_results.json` (11.7 MB) is shipped but "poison" appears in neither .tex.** Either an unreferenced experiment is being distributed or a cut waystation left its data behind.

---

### Verified correct

Worth stating so the report is calibrated: bibliography is clean (9 entries, 9 cited keys, zero orphans, `warning$ -- 0`). Hedges' g is exactly right — J = 1−3/27 = 0.889, −2.58 × 0.889 = −2.29, an 11% correction. W3 arithmetic checks (270 arms, 0.4%, layers [35,47,59] and strength 10.0 confirmed in the data). W5's confab arm is real and correctly hedged — the data has exactly 6 `hon_*` and 3 `fab_*` prompts. v2 deceptive trials are genuinely spread across all four payoffs (2/2/1/2). Power claims are defensible.

**On the structural defect you asked me to hunt:** it is *not* present between these two editions. Both bookmark trees (`main.out`, `academic/main.out`) are structurally identical — 9 sections, same subsection order, all four tables under the same headings, identical row order within every table. Neither PDF is stale by mtime (root: tex 12:51 → pdf 22:24 Jul 28; academic: both Sep 1 12:48). The defect appears instead in the form of finding #4.

---

### What I could NOT check

- **External citations — UNCHECKED.** WebFetch permission was denied. I did not verify that arXiv:2602.02315, 2603.05494, 2504.00285, or 2412.14093 exist, or that titles and authors are right. FABRICATED_AUTHOR_NAMES is unresolved. One name for a human to confirm, offered as a flag and *not* a finding: the bib says "Casademunt, Hugo"; the researcher I associate with censored-model knowledge-elicitation work is Helena Casademunt. I did not verify this and am not confident.
- **Dead URLs — UNCHECKED.** No network. Both are described as private, so a 404 wouldn't distinguish wrong-org from private; the README cross-check in #10 is the stronger evidence.
- **PDF content vs source.** I read bookmark files, not rendered text. Confirming the PDFs carry the current tables needs `pdftotext` — Bash python and PowerShell script execution were both denied.
- **v1 game-theory data.** Not in `data/`. Needed for 53%, 40/75, Table 3, and the "12 excluded" figure.
- **"30/45 prompt×condition groups show different outcomes."** Needs a group-by; scripting blocked.
- **Author sign-off.** Whether Lyra, CC, Wilkes, and Kavi approve the current text — requires asking them.
- **Whether the pre-Sep-1 academic PDF was distributed** — needs the Zenodo/venue record.

The blocking items are #1–#4. #1 and #3 mean the abstract's two lead numbers are wrong or unbacked; #4 means a retracted claim is still a section title.
